title: Simpler structure for annotation
observed_strengths: One intact potted specimen, visible shoot tip and main stem, no blue cage. A useful second example with broader, drooping leaves.
limitations: The pot bottom is cropped and foliage overlaps. Some lower tissue is yellow; the top of the frame contains substantial empty background.
attribution: Rachel Burton; APPF Plant Accelerator, University of Adelaide; UA (Gill) hemp phenotyping dataset

title: Denser comparison specimen
observed_strengths: One potted specimen with more overlapping foliage and visible side branches, photographed in the same controlled imaging system.
limitations: Yellow/brown lower tissue, dark leaves and a cropped pot bottom. Keep this variation explicit rather than treating it as an ideal healthy plant.
attribution: Rachel Burton; APPF Plant Accelerator, University of Adelaide; UA (Gill) hemp phenotyping dataset

title: Best whole-plant candidate
observed_strengths: One upright, branched specimen with its shoot tip visible, a plain black background, and no support cage. Individual leaf edges and branching are distinguishable.
limitations: The pot bottom is cropped; upper leaves are dark; yellow basal tissue is present. This is not evidence of a mature production canopy.
attribution: Rachel Burton; APPF Plant Accelerator, University of Adelaide; UA (Gill) hemp phenotyping dataset

title: Same specimen from an elevated camera
observed_strengths: Same plant ID and timestamp as 084847-W. This original elevated view shows the pot and mounting carrier, offering extra structural context.
limitations: This is not a magnified crop or registered stereo pair. Imaging hardware occupies the background and the plant uses fewer pixels.
attribution: Rachel Burton; APPF Plant Accelerator, University of Adelaide; UA (Gill) hemp phenotyping dataset
